html: † עַכְבָּר n.m. 1 S 6:4 mouse (NH id.; Aramaic עַכְבְּרָא; Syriac (in Lexx) ܥܽܘܩܒܪܳܐ, ܐܰܓܒܪܳܐ (PS22); Arabic عَكَابِرُ pl. mares murum Frey (Kam.), cf. also HomAS 338; Arabic of jerboa RSK 302; v. TristrNHB 122 FFP10 ff.);—abs. הָע׳ unclean Lv 11:29 (H), Is 66:17 (cf. RSSem i. 275, 2nd ed. 293); pl. cstr. עַכְבְּרֵי (ה)זָהָב 1 S 6:4, 11, 18; sf. צַלְמֵי עַכְבְּרֵיכֶם v 5.
